'''Andrew Benedict Wittkower''' (November 7, 1934 – March 14, 2026) was a British-born Canadian-American physicist.

== Early life and career ==
Wittkower was born in [[London]] on November 7, 1934, the son of Eric David Wittkower and Claire Francesca Weil. At an early age, he and his family emigrated to [[Canada]], settling in [[Montreal]], [[Quebec]]. He attended [[McGill University]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degree]] in 1955. He also attended the [[University of Cambridge]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1959. In the same year, he emigrated to the [[United States]], but returned and attended the [[University College London]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[atomic physics]] in 1961.<ref name="a">{{Citation|title=Biography and Genealogy Master Index|publisher=Gale Research Company|date=2000}}</ref> While attending at London, in 1960, he was named a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=wittkower&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=March 17, 2026}}</ref>

Wittkower worked as a [[Scientist|research scientist]] at [[High Voltage Engineering Corporation]] until 1970. During the 1970s and 1980s, he co-authored peer-reviewed studies on [[ion implantation]] systems and [[semiconductor]] processing equipment.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wittkower |first1=A.B. |last2=Betz |first2=H.D. |title=Equilibrium-charge-state distributions of energetic ions (Z > 2) in gaseous and solid media |journal=Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables |date=1973 |volume=5 |issue=2 |pages=113–166 |doi=10.1016/S0092-640X(73)80001-4 |bibcode=1973AD......5..113W }}{{psc|date=August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Wittkower |first1=Andrew B. |last2=Guerra |first2=Michael A. |title=SIMOX: Buried layer formation by ion implantation — Equipment and techniques |journal=Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research Section B: Beam Interactions with Materials and Atoms |date=February 1989 |volume=37-38 |pages=512–517 |doi=10.1016/0168-583X(89)90235-8 |bibcode=1989NIMPB..37..512W }}{{psc|date=August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ryding |first1=G. |last2=Wittkower |first2=A. |title=Industrial Ion Implantation Machines |journal=IEEE Transactions on Manufacturing Technology |date=September 1975 |volume=4 |issue=1 |pages=21–31 |doi=10.1109/TMFT.1975.1135858 |bibcode=1975ITMT....4...21R }}{{psc|date=August 2026}}</ref> He served as co-founder of Ibis Technology from 1986 to 1991, and was president of High Temperature Engineering Corporation from 1992 to 1995.<ref name="a" /> In 2001, he was named a [[Lists of fellows of the IEEE|fellow]] of the [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]], "for contributions and leadership in the development and advancement of ion implantation techniques, equipment and companies".<ref>{{Cite Wittkower|work=[[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|IEEE Fellows Directory]]|access-date=March 17, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
In 1957, Wittkower married Mary Shotter,<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/420535220/|title=Wittkower--Shotter|work=[[The Gazette (Montreal)|The Gazette]]|location=[[Montreal]], [[Quebec]], [[Canada]]|date=August 22, 1957|access-date=March 17, 2026|page=17|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref> a [[World War II]] [[Cryptanalysis|codebreaker]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://foodformarriage.com/2020/07/12/remembering-simple/|title=Remembering Folly Cove|work=Food For Marriage|first=Ken|last=Carlton|date=July 12, 2020|access-date=March 17, 2026}}</ref> Their marriage lasted until her death in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.greelyfuneralhome.com/obituaries/Mary-N-Wittkower?obId=12671869#/obituaryInfo|title=Mary N. Wittkower|work=Greely Funeral Home|access-date=March 17, 2026}}</ref>

Wittkower died on March 14, 2026, at the age of 91.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.greelyfuneralhome.com/obituaries/Andrew-B-Wittkower?obId=47721465#/obituaryInfo|title=Andrew B. Wittkower|work=Greely Funeral Home|access-date=March 17, 2026}}</ref>
